steps.title: Sample Preparation and Lysis
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for RNA extraction by removing preservative and adding lysis buffers.

substeps.instruction: Transfer sample into a 1.5ml collection tube
Pipette off RNALATER
Add 600 µL Buffer RLT
Add 6 µL Beta-mercaptoethanol

steps.title: Homogenization via Qiashredder
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample using a Qiashredder column.

substeps.instruction: Pipette sample into Qiashredder column and spin for 00:02:00 @ 8,000rpm
Remove Qiashredder column, add cap, and spin for 00:03:00 @ max speed

steps.title: Lysate Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysate for column binding by adding ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL 70% Ethanol to a new collection tube
Transfer lysate to the collection tube and mix with 70% Ethanol by pipetting

steps.title: RNA Binding and Washing
steps.instruction: Bind RNA to the RNeasy column and perform wash steps.

substeps.instruction: Transfer lysate to RNeasy column (700 µL at a time), spin for 00:00:15 @ 9,800rpm, and discard flow through; repeat for the remaining lysate
Add 700 µL Buffer RWI and spin for 00:00:15 @ 9,800rpm
Add 500 µL Buffer RPE, spin for 00:00:15 @ 9,800rpm, and discard flow through
Add 500 µL Buffer RPE, spin for 00:01:00 @ 9,800rpm, discard flow through, and spin for 00:02:00 @ 13,000rpm

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Elute with 30 µL RNAse-Free H20 and spin for 00:01:00 @ 13,00rpm
Elute again with 30 µL RNAse-Free H20 and spin for 00:01:00 @ 13,00rpm
Combine mRNA and RNAse-free H20 to standardize all samples to aliquots containing 0.4μg mRNA total in 10μl

steps.title: First-Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription to synthesize cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Master Mix 1: add 1 µL dntp mix and 2 µL dT primer per sample
Prepare Master Mix 2: add 4 µL Buffer, 4 µL DTT and 0.5 µL RNAase inhibitor per sample
Pipette 3 µL of Master Mix 1 into each sample
Place sample on dry bath at 65 °C for 00:05:00
Pipette 6.5 µL of Master Mix 2 into each sample
Incubate samples at 42 °C for 00:50:00

steps.title: PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the target sequence using PCR.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a PCR master mix per sample containing: 2.0 µL 10X Buffer, 1.0 µL 50mM MgSO4, 0.5 µL dNTP mix (10mM each), 18.4 µL ddH2O, 1 µL forward primer (10μM), 1 µL reverse primer (10μM), and 0.5 µL taq polymerase
Add 24 µL of Master Mix to each PCR tube
Add 1 µL of sample for a total volume of 25 µL per tube
